title: When comparison keeps stealing steadiness under pressure
issueStatement: The mind keeps measuring worth and direction against other people. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Gurbani returns dignity to remembrance, contentment, and the work in front of you. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart.
actionPrompt: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
